name: Jove Eight
explanation: An eight-voice, sixteen-oscillator polyphonic analog synthesizer modelled control-for-control on the Roland Jupiter-8 (JP-8 Owner's Manual, read cover to cover). Each voice has two VCOs: VCO-1 (triangle / sawtooth / variable pulse / square, ranges 16'-2') with a CROSS MOD slider that FM/ring-modulates its pitch from VCO-2; and VCO-2 (sine / sawtooth / variable pulse / noise, quantized ranges 16'-2', FINE tune +/-50 cents, a NORMAL/LOW-FREQ switch that turns it into a sub-audio modulator, and a SYNC switch that hard-syncs it to VCO-1). The VCO MODULATOR routes the LFO and ENV-1 to the pitch of VCO-1 / BOTH / VCO-2, and drives PULSE WIDTH MOD in MANUAL / LFO / ENV-1 mode. A rotary SOURCE MIX balances the two VCOs into a non-resonant -6 dB/oct High-Pass Filter and then the signature VCF: resonant low-pass with a -12 dB/oct vs -24 dB/oct SLOPE switch, ENV MOD (with an ENV-1/ENV-2 selector), LFO MOD and 0-120% KEY FOLLOW. The VCA is driven by ENV-2 with a four-position LFO-tremolo depth. Two complete four-stage ADSR envelopes: ENV-1 (assignable, with a KEY FOLLOW time-scaler and a NORMAL/INVERSE POLARITY switch) and ENV-2 (with KEY FOLLOW), A 1ms-5s, D/R 1ms-10s. The LFO offers sine / sawtooth / square / random(S&H) waveforms, 0.05-40 Hz, and a DELAY that fades it in per note. Full performance section: polyphonic PORTAMENTO (off/on/upper), a center-sprung BENDER routable to VCO-1 / VCO-2 / VCF with independent bend-sensitivity, and an auxiliary LFO-MOD touch pad with RISE TIME and VCO/VCF depths. Assigner: POLY-1 / POLY-2 / SOLO / UNISON (8-voice stack). A 1-4 octave UP / DOWN / U&D / RANDOM arpeggiator with internal rate and HOLD. Eight-voice polyphony. Switch groups are bit-packed into single host parameters; the panel decodes and shows every individual switch. Dual/Split two-patch key modes and the tape/patch-memory system are host concerns and out of scope (Whole mode single patch).
